device: Android Emulator 35 (system-images;android-35;google_apis;arm64-v8a, build AE3A.240806.043 userdebug), AVD ouo-step5-bench: pixel_7 profile 1080x2400 @420dpi, 4 vCPU, 4 GiB RAM, -gpu swiftshader_indirect, headless (-no-window)
host: Mac17,2 (Apple M5, 32 GB), macOS 27.0.1, Android Emulator 37.2.13.0

sdk_versions.ouo_android: sdk/android @ 3e9e2c11 (modules signals, signals-core, replay, replay-core; vendored unchanged)
sdk_versions.sentry_android: 8.63.0 (sentry-android-core, sentry-android-replay, sentry-okhttp; sentry-android umbrella with NDK for size only)
sdk_versions.host_app: AGP 8.12.0, Kotlin 2.1.20, compileSdk/targetSdk 35, minSdk 24, OkHttp 4.12.0 in every variant, release + R8 + shrinkResources, arm64-v8a only

not_measured.what: ouo Android handled-error capture, HTTP spans, traces/logs/metrics export (OTLP) in the native host
not_measured.why: sdk/android has no native init, exporter or handled-error/HTTP API today; in the React Native SDK those live in JS (@ouo11y/react-native) and only replay + signals are native. The ouo variants therefore send replay chunks only; the handled error and the 3 HTTP calls per Fetch produce no ouo telemetry, while Sentry reports them (error event, OkHttp spans, transactions, sessions). Wire and CPU deltas are not like-for-like on that part.

not_measured.what: ouo signals' wire cost (crash / hang / termination reports)
not_measured.why: Signals writes crash.json/run.json and hands the previous run's report to the host at the next launch; the native host has no sender (the RN JS SDK sends it). No crash or hang was provoked in the journey.

not_measured.what: ouo full SDK as shipped (React Native app examples/ouo-mobile: JS SDK + native replay + signals)
not_measured.why: Not run: an RN app's own baseline (Hermes, RN runtime) would swamp a native comparison against sentry-android, and building the Expo example (prebuild + C++ build) was out of the time budget of this step. The native host measures exactly the Kotlin code the RN SDK vendors.

not_measured.what: Runtime cost of sentry-android with NDK (variant sentryfull)
not_measured.why: Measured for size only; the NDK handler adds a native crash handler, not per-minute work, and the runtime runs cover sentry-android-core (+replay).

not_measured.what: Device (real hardware) CPU, memory and energy
not_measured.why: Emulator only (no physical phone by rule). Guest GL is emulated (-gpu swiftshader_indirect), so the app's RenderThread burns ~13 s CPU per journey minute even in the baseline; PixelCopy and JPEG/MP4 encoding costs differ from a phone's GPU and hardware codecs (Sentry replay encodes MP4 through MediaCodec, here a software encoder). Battery/energy cannot be measured on an emulator.

not_measured.what: Frame timing (jank) impact via dumpsys gfxinfo, and simpleperf profiles
not_measured.why: Not collected: with emulated GL the frame times reflect the emulator, not the SDKs; per-thread /proc CPU attribution is used instead.

method:
One native host app (host/, Kotlin, no AndroidX, OkHttp 4.12.0 in every variant) built release with R8 + resource shrinking, arm64-v8a only, one product flavor per variant: baseline (no SDK), ouosignals (sdk/android Signals.init + install), ouofull (Signals + OuoReplay.start, mode SESSION, 1 s frame interval, default masks), sentrycore (sentry-android-core + sentry-okhttp interceptor, tracesSampleRate 1.0, defaults otherwise), sentryreplay (sentrycore + sentry-android-replay, sessionSampleRate 1.0), sentryfull (sentry-android umbrella incl. NDK; size only). Both SDKs are initialised by hand in Application.onCreate (Sentry auto-init off) and init_ms is the wall time of that call (SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos; Sentry finishes part of its setup on background threads afterwards, ouo replay posts its start to the main looper). Size: size_bytes = uncompressed APK entries minus baseline, size_zipped_bytes = APK file size minus baseline (debug-signed; scripts/sizes.py). Runtime (scripts/run_bench.py, round-robin over variants so contention spreads evenly; 3 complete rounds, so n = 3 per variant: small, treat medians as indicative and look at min/max): force-stop + pm clear, `am start -W` cold launch (cold_start_ms = TotalTime), 8 s settle, 30 s idle on the static Home screen, then a 60 s scripted journey by adb input (4 cycles of 15 s: Home Fetch = 2 GET + 1 POST via OkHttp to the capture server's API port, open a 300-row ListView and fling 3 times, back, open Detail, Fetch again, one handled error in the first cycle only, back), then 10 s grace. CPU = utime+stime of the app process from /proc/<pid>/stat (root via adb root; CLK_TCK 100) over the journey, scaled to ms per minute; per-thread attribution from /proc/<pid>/task/*/stat. Memory = Pss/Rss from /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup (read by root, the app is not involved; excludes GPU/graphics mtrack that dumpsys meminfo would add): idle = after settle, peak = max of 5 samples during the journey; peak_rss_hwm = VmHWM at the end. Wire = every request the capture server (scripts/capture_server.py, answers 200) got on the telemetry port 8712 from journey start to end of grace, body bytes as sent (both SDKs gzip) + request line and headers, divided by the journey minutes; Sentry DSN http://pub@10.0.2.2:8712/1, ouo replay endpoint http://10.0.2.2:8712. Medians with p90/min/max over runs; deltas are median minus baseline median. Emulator numbers: CPU absolute values are inflated by emulated GL (RenderThread), compare deltas, not absolutes, and expect a phone to differ.
 Host load: these runs were made on a quiet Mac after an earlier contended run (load 15 to 480) was discarded; the load sampler (scripts/load_sampler.sh) logged the Mac's load average every 10 s from before the first round, joined to each run (host_load_per_run). 3 complete rounds per variant, interleaved.
